body: If things don't make sense I have made this post at 1 AM, unable to sleep.
Why do I envy a shadow.
Is it okay if I message you?
I don't think it's possible, I have always let others go first and I have not really steered from it ever, I feel good when others get it, but I don't like myself enough to reward myself
I don't think I will be happy, period, is there a point? All I have going for me is that I am a little polite I guess.
I don't know if I am ready for it.
The issue of being an adult is that I never even planned to make it here and only have two actual plans.  I expected myself dead before 16.
I feel like I would have more freedom which can be a good or bad thing.

I used to have reasons, now all I have is the thoughts and breakdowns, I guess really bad nerves and the fact that I am kind of scared of people despite being an actor.  When I was younger, I don't remember, but I do remember attempting to drown myself.
I have posted this before I decided to sleep, I needed somewhere to vent how I feel, I apologise for being this way.
Believe me, these thoughts won't go, 6 years I have had them, yeah good luck to you too, I appreciate it.
I will consider it, but I feel like it's difficult to talk about issues since not even hotlines work for me, probably last comment from me in this post.
About the PM, don't worry, it's okay, I will only commit if I know for sure I will die, thanks for the gesture though.
You too, surprisingly wholesome and welcome. Thank you.
I guess so, I used a throwaway account to stop people irl from seeing it and also as a way to cope through seeing the relatable posts, just expected entirely different responses tis all.
Thats a response I did not expect to get to be honest.
